summary.text: Brandon Storm is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 21, serving since 2021. The legislature's profile lists Storm as chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee and a member of the Banking & Insurance and Transportation committees.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Brandon J. Storm was born on May 14, 1976, and is an attorney with Brandon J. Storm PLLC.
The profile lists a B.S. in police administration from Eastern Kentucky University and a J.D. from Mississippi College School of Law.
It also lists his membership at Corinth Baptist Church, where he teaches Sunday school, and a board seat with the Laurel London Optimist Club.
The profile shows him as chair of the 2026 Regular Session Senate Impeachment Committee and as non-voting co-chair of the Juvenile Justice Oversight Council.
